timeline.summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
timeline.quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

timeline.summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
timeline.quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer asks Aminatou to mind Yoshimaru while the team goes in.
timeline.quote: Will you mind Yoshimaru for me?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
timeline.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.
